LESSON: SELF- EXPRESSION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Self- expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Self- expression, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How do you call each other in your family? 2. What work is done by family members?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Self- expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Unity: Cooperation as the learner appreciates the role played by each member of the family to keep them together.

● Social justice: Responsibility as the learner learns the importance of fairness in sharing work and responsibilities among family

members.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Socio-economic issues awareness where the learner understands that parents work in different places and earn differently.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Self-expression is a life skill necessary in all learning areas for learners to answer questions in class, for daily communications and

for expression of needs.
